title: Dynomark transport contract v1
description: Every frame on either hop is exactly one of these messages, discriminated by type. See README.md.

Id.description: Opaque identifier chosen by its owner (request id by the extension; job, batch, event, diff and item ids by the daemon). Compare byte-for-byte; never parse.

NodeId.description: A browser bookmark node id, per profile (Chrome: decimal string; Firefox: guid). Opaque to the daemon.

HostId.description: The daemon host's id from its Config; also the suffix of its writer marker folder title.

Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor minted by the daemon. Printable ASCII; echo it back unchanged.

EpochMs.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, UTC.

Url.description: A raw URL exactly as the browser reports it. The extension never normalizes.

Identity.description: The normalized URL of a corpus entry. Computed only by the daemon; the extension may echo one it received, never compute one.

Title.description: A bookmark, folder or page title.

RootKey.description: A browser top-level folder, independent of browser and locale. bar = bookmarks bar / toolbar; other = other bookmarks; mobile = mobile bookmarks; menu = Firefox bookmarks menu.

FolderPath.description: A folder addressed by path: the top-level folder, then folder titles downward. names [] is the top-level folder itself. Resolution picks, at each level, the child FOLDER with the lowest index whose title equals the name exactly.

HostRole.description: The daemon's role from its Config.

CaptureSource.description: Where captured text came from. fetch is set only by the daemon.

MoveOrigin.description: extension = the move was made by an operation of a batch this extension was applying; user = anything else.

HelloMode.description: What the connection may do, decided by the daemon from the two contract versions. full = versions equal. read_only = extension newer than daemon: only the read-only message set (README). refused = extension older than daemon: nothing but hello.

ErrorCode.description: Closed set. Retryable (same request id, after backoff): busy, internal. All others are final for that request.

SkipReason.description: Why an operation was skipped rather than applied. node_missing: its node no longer exists. parent_mismatch: expect.parent_path or expect.parent_id did not hold. not_empty: expect.empty did not hold. unknown_after_resume: the op was in the prefix applied before the extension restarted and its outcome cannot be re-derived.

FailReason.description: Why an operation without a matching expect clause failed. node_missing: move/remove of a node that does not exist. parent_missing: the target folder (parent, to, or the graveyard root) does not resolve. browser_error: the browser API refused.

RejectReason.description: boundary: an operation targets or takes a node from outside the owned roots and the batch carries no diff_item_id. invalid: the batch is malformed (e.g. op indices not 0..n-1).

UndoDropReason.description: Why the undo guard dropped an inverse operation. node_moved: the node is no longer where the batch left it. node_missing: the node no longer exists. not_empty: a folder the batch created now holds items.

Detail.description: Human-readable detail for logs and UI; never parsed.

OwnedRoots.description: The three folders Dynomark owns, as the daemon resolves them for this connection.

Bookmark.description: A bookmark as the extension sees it. path is the folder that contains it. No identity: the daemon computes that.

Capture.description: Readable text captured by the extension. source none means nothing was captured and text is empty; an ingest without capture means the same.

source.$comment: fetch is daemon-only and never travels in a Capture.

Job.description: The daemon's unit of work for one ingested save, keyed on (node_id, identity). capture_source is present once capture resolved; batch_id is the latest batch that files this job's node; last_error is present when state is FAILED.

SnapshotNode.description: One node of the browser tree. url present = bookmark, absent = folder. parent_id null only for the browser's root node. index is the position among siblings. Titles and urls are not length-capped here (only the frame limit applies) because the snapshot must represent the tree as it is.

Snapshot.description: The full bookmark tree as the extension read it at taken_at, flat. Exactly one node has parent_id null; node ids are unique.

root_ids.description: Node id of each top-level folder present in this browser, keyed by RootKey.

Expect.description: Precondition re-checked by the extension at apply time. Every present clause must hold: the node is directly in the folder parent_path resolves to / its parent node id is parent_id / it is a folder with no children. If any clause fails, or the node does not exist, the op is SKIPPED (not failed).

OpCreateFolder.description: Create folder title directly in parent unless a child folder with exactly that title exists (then no-op). The parent must already exist. Result node id: the folder's.

OpCreate.description: Create a bookmark directly in parent unless a child bookmark with exactly this url exists (then no-op). The parent must already exist. Result node id: the bookmark's.

OpMove.description: Move node_id to the end of folder to, unless it is already directly in it (then no-op). Result node id: node_id.

OpRemove.description: Remove-to-graveyard: move node_id to the end of owned_roots.graveyard (from this connection's hello.result), unless already directly in it. Never deletes. Result node id: node_id.

Operation.description: One path-idempotent tree operation; discriminated by op.

WriteBatch.description: Ordered operations the extension applies. operations[i].index == i. diff_item_id present = the batch realizes an accepted DiffItem and may cross the owned-roots boundary. The inverse stays on the daemon.

ReceiptApplied.description: Every op was applied or skipped; applied and skipped indices partition 0..n-1, each list in ascending index order.

ReceiptPartial.description: Ops 0..failed.index-1 were applied or skipped (partitioned by applied/skipped, ascending); failed.index failed; later ops were not attempted.

BatchReceipt.description: The extension's answer for a batch; discriminated by state. snapshot is the tree read immediately before this apply attempt touched the tree (for a resumed or already-applied batch: read at the start of this attempt).

Move.description: An observed tree move. url present for a bookmark, absent for a folder.

LocalIndexRow.description: One corpus entry for tier-1 search. At most 512 bytes as compact UTF-8 JSON (README); path is the folder that holds the entry.

Hit.description: A ranked search match. score: higher is better, comparable only within one tier. Hits on the wire are always tier corpus.

EntryRef.description: A reference to a corpus entry: its identity, title and the folder that holds it.

Citation.description: A corpus entry the answer cites; always one the retrieval step returned.

Turn.description: One earlier chat exchange: the user's text and the answer text shown.

Answer.description: A grounded reply. external_urls are URLs the answer mentions that are not in the corpus.

PlacementReason.description: Why an entry was placed where it was.

UndoDrop.description: An inverse operation the undo guard dropped; index is the ORIGINAL batch's op index it would have reverted.

DiffItem.description: One line of a TreeDiff. operations[i].index == i. accepted_at null = proposed; set = accepted (recorded by the daemon).

OutlineFolder.description: One folder of the owned subtree; path is the folder's own path. item_count counts its direct bookmark children.

TreeOutline.description: The folder skeleton of the owned subtree (a page of it on the wire), parents before children. No URLs. Writer marker folders are excluded.

ModelInfo.description: A configured model id and whether it runs on this machine (false = requests leave the machine).

Hello.description: First request on every connection. v is the extension's contract version; follow_up is the Follow Up folder the extension resolved.

v.description: Contract version of the sender. Any version: this message's shape is frozen across versions.

HelloResult.description: The daemon's answer to hello. v is the daemon's contract version.

v.description: Contract version of the sender. Any version: this message's shape is frozen across versions.

Ingest.description: Submit a save. Idempotent on (bookmark.node_id, identity(bookmark.url)). backfill true = index but never file.

IngestResult.description: The job for this save (the existing one on a repeat).

JobRetry.description: User retry of a FAILED job (FAILED -> QUEUED). On a job in any other state: no-op.

TreeSnapshot.description: The full tree, sent after hello and (debounced) after changes under the owned roots. The daemon keeps the one with the latest taken_at.

MoveObserved.description: A tree move observed by the extension between owned folders. Idempotent on (node_id, observed_at).

MoveObservedResult.description: Move recorded (or discarded by the daemon's rules; the answer is the same).

BatchReceiptMessage.description: The outcome of applying an offered batch; acknowledges its batch.offer event. Idempotent on batch_id: the first receipt recorded wins.

EventsReplay.description: Ask the daemon to re-send every unacknowledged event on this connection.

EventsReplayResult.description: Sent after every replayed event frame; count is how many were re-sent.

EventsAck.description: Acknowledge job.updated events. Unknown or already-acked ids, and batch.offer ids (acked only by a receipt), are ignored.

IndexPull.description: Pull one page of the LocalIndex. No cursor = first page.

IndexPullResult.description: One page; next_cursor null = last page.

Search.description: Tier-2 search over the corpus. Later pages repeat the same query with the cursor.

SearchResult.description: One page of corpus hits, best first.

Ask.description: A chat question with the conversation so far (oldest first).

PlacementExplain.description: Why an entry is where it is. Exactly one of identity (echoed from the daemon) or url (raw).

Undo.description: Undo an APPLIED batch. Idempotent on batch_id: at most one inverse batch per batch.

UndoResult.description: batch_id is the inverse batch, offered by a batch.offer event; null when the guard dropped every operation.

DiffPropose.description: Propose a TreeDiff. A retry with the same request id returns the same diff.

DiffProposeResult.description: The proposed diff; its items are read with diff.page.

DiffPage.description: Read one page of a diff's items.

DiffAccept.description: Accept one DiffItem. The daemon records accepted_at, builds the batch and offers it. Idempotent on item_id.

DiffAcceptResult.description: The recorded acceptance and the batch it produced.

OutlineGet.description: Read one page of the owned TreeOutline (for the pin/lock settings view).

FolderFlagsSet.description: Set pinned and/or locked on one owned folder.

FolderFlagsSetResult.description: The folder with its flags now.

WriterStatus.description: Writer-marker status from the latest snapshot.

WriterStatusResult.description: own_marker: this host's marker is in the tree. other_writers: host ids of other markers. conflict == (role is writer and other_writers is non-empty).

Status.description: Daemon status for the settings page.

StatusResult.description: queue_depth counts jobs in QUEUED, CAPTURING, ENRICHED or PLACED.

Error.description: The one error response. re is the request id, or null when the request's id could not be read.

v.description: Contract version of the sender. Any version: this message's shape is frozen across versions.

JobUpdated.description: A job changed state. Acked by events.ack.

BatchOffer.description: A batch for the extension to apply. Acked only by a batch.receipt for batch.batch_id.
